profile.description: Active county fair, but Mohave County Risk Management does not allow inflatables on the property due to safety risks.

notes.subject: Risk Management prohibits inflatables on property
notes.body: Shana Westbrook replied Aug. 13, 2026 that Mohave County Risk Management does not allow inflatables on the property due to safety risks and provided 928-753-0736 for clarification. Current official fair information confirms the Sept. 17-20, 2026 fair is active and has a conventional carnival. This is a structural property restriction; do not repeatedly pursue unless Risk Management policy changes.
